metadata.description: Official plugin marketplace for the AI-Driven Development framework

plugins.name: aidd-context
plugins.description: Knowledge production: project bootstrap, project init, generation of context artifacts (skills, agents, rules, commands, hooks), mermaid diagrams, learn, discovery

plugins.name: aidd-dev
plugins.description: Code transformation: plan, implement, assert, audit, review, test, refactor, debug, for-sure.

plugins.name: aidd-vcs
plugins.description: External artifacts: commit, pull-request, release-tag, issue-create

plugins.name: aidd-pm
plugins.description: Product backlog artifacts, refinement, Product Briefs, Epics, User Stories, Tasks, Spikes, Defects, requirements, and specs.

plugins.name: aidd-orchestrator
plugins.description: Orchestration: synchronous SDLC pipeline, async issue-to-PR automation, and product backlog. Hosts the generic agents.

plugins.name: aidd-refine
plugins.description: Meta-cognition: refine input through brainstorming, refine output through challenge, blind-spot scanning, and fact-checking.

plugins.name: aidd-ui
plugins.description: ALPHA, not ready for use. UI and UX concern: design, review, and improve frontend interfaces.

plugins.name: aidd-telemetry
plugins.description: Measurement: counts the tokens of Claude Code and Codex sessions per task, ticket, model, tool and day, locally. The hooks ask for a task on plain node; its two skills reach the `aidd` CLI to turn it on and answer.

plugins.name: aidd-qa
plugins.description: Acceptance QA: validates observable behavior against acceptance criteria and records reviewer evidence. Browser is the only supported interface today.
